PowerPointテンプレート無料ダウンロード | html2pptx.app

name: html2pptx.app
summary: Hosted API, MCP server and CLI that turn slide-oriented HTML/CSS into editable PowerPoint.
description: Converts HTML/CSS slides into PPTX through an asynchronous REST API, a remote MCP endpoint, agent Skills and a CLI. Supported text and simple shapes stay editable while SVGs, icons and complex structures are rasterized; 50 official templates, a local visual editor that writes back to the source HTML, and Free/paid plans.
contains: REST API, remote MCP endpoint, Skills and CLI channels
supported text and simple shapes stay editable; SVG, icons and complex structures rasterized
supports flexbox, grid, gradients, shadows, border radius, transforms
Free Preview 10 conversions/mo, Founder Beta $7/mo, Business $59/mo
local visual editor writes edits back to the source HTML
